subject: spanish
topicDisplay: Topic 5 Social Activities Fitness And Health
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: What is “la Tomatina” in Buñol famous for?
questions.explain: “La Tomatina” is a festival where people throw tomatoes at each other in a giant food fight.

questions.q: What does “las legumbres” mean?
questions.explain: “Las legumbres” are “pulses/legumes” such as beans, lentils and chickpeas.

questions.q: What does “El Día de los Muertos” mean?
questions.explain: “El Día de los Muertos” (the Day of the Dead) is a Mexican festival honouring deceased relatives.

questions.q: Which sentence means “The whole family gets together to have dinner”?
options: Toda la familia se reúne para comer
Todo la familia se reúne para cenar
Toda la familia se reúne para desayunar
Toda la familia se reúne para cenar
questions.explain: “Reunirse” = to get together and “cenar” = to have dinner: “Toda la familia se reúne para cenar”.

questions.q: What does “dar un paseo” mean?
questions.explain: “Dar un paseo” means “to go for a walk/stroll”.

questions.q: What does 'llevar una vida sana' mean?
questions.explain: 'Sano/a' means 'healthy', so 'llevar una vida sana' = 'to lead a healthy life'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'You must avoid sugary drinks'?
options: Hay que evitar las bebidas azucaradas
questions.explain: 'Hay que' = 'one must' and 'evitar' = 'to avoid', so 'Hay que evitar las bebidas azucaradas' = 'You must avoid sugary drinks'.

questions.q: What does 'la Nochebuena' mean?
questions.explain: 'La Nochebuena' (24 December) means 'Christmas Eve'; 'la Nochevieja' is New Year's Eve.

questions.q: What is 'La Tomatina', held in Buñol?
options: A festival where people throw tomatoes
questions.explain: 'La Tomatina' is a famous Spanish festival in which participants throw tomatoes at each other.

questions.q: How do you say “We light candles and sing songs”?
questions.explain: “Encender velas” = to light candles and “cantar canciones” = to sing songs.

questions.q: How do you say “I have a headache”?
questions.explain: “Me duele la cabeza” = “my head hurts / I have a headache”.

questions.q: How do you say “I like reading novels”?
questions.explain: “Leer novelas” = to read novels, so “Me gusta leer novelas”.

questions.q: What does 'el bienestar' mean?
questions.explain: 'El bienestar' literally means 'being well' and translates as 'wellbeing'.

questions.q: How do you say “I find horror films scary”?
options: Las películas de terror me dan risa
La película de terror me dan miedo
Las películas de terror me dan miedo
Las películas de terror me dan igual
questions.explain: “Dar miedo” = “to frighten”, so “me dan miedo” = “they scare me”.

questions.q: What does “una película de dibujos animados” mean?
questions.explain: “Dibujos animados” means “cartoons”, so it is “an animated/cartoon film”.

questions.q: What is celebrated in Spain on 'el Día de los Reyes Magos' (6 January)?
options: The Three Kings / Epiphany, when children get presents
questions.explain: 'Los Reyes Magos' are the Three Kings; on 6 January Spanish children traditionally receive their presents.

questions.q: What does “montar a caballo” mean?
questions.explain: “Montar a caballo” means “to go horse riding”.

questions.q: How do you say “I gave up sweets to be healthier”?
options: Dejé de comer dulces para estar más enfermo
Dejo de comer dulces para estar más sano
Dejé de comer dulces para estar más sano
Empecé a comer dulces para estar más sano
questions.explain: “Dejar de” + infinitive = “to give up/stop”, so “Dejé de comer dulces” = “I gave up eating sweets”.

questions.q: Which means 'I used to play football every weekend' (habitual past)?
options: Jugaba al fútbol todos los fines de semana
Jugaré al fútbol todos los fines de semana
Jugué al fútbol todos los fines de semana
Juego al fútbol todos los fines de semana
questions.explain: Habitual past actions use the imperfect: 'jugaba' = 'I used to play'.

questions.q: Which sentence means “Junk food is bad for your health”?
options: La comida basura es mala para la salud
La comida basura está mala para la salud
La comida basura es buena para la salud
La comida sana es mala para la salud
questions.explain: “La comida basura” = junk food and “mala para la salud” = bad for your health.

questions.q: Which sentence means “I'm trying to eat less sugar”?
questions.explain: “Intento comer menos azúcar” = “I'm trying to eat less sugar”.

questions.q: How do you say “At weekends I go out with my friends”?
options: Los fines de semana salgo con mi familia
Los fines de semana salgo con mis amigos
Los fines de semana salí con mis amigos
Los fines de semana sale con mis amigos
questions.explain: “Salgo con mis amigos” = “I go out with my friends”, in the present for a routine.
